research_scope: Owner requested comparative gameplay research, no production edits or build

proposed_design_lessons.lesson: Make Master interventions intelligible and accessible before the danger resolves.
proposed_design_lessons.proposal: Show target, danger footprint and protected NPC consequence; keep Move/Protect/Focus visible. Teach first dodge safely. Consider an optional tactical pause or first-encounter planning beat only if owner accepts it; do not silently migrate to turn-based combat.
proposed_design_lessons.acceptance: A fresh portrait user identifies the threatened hero/NPC and uses a visible movement response; inspection preserves autonomy.

proposed_design_lessons.lesson: Give each route a useful benefit with a different cost, then make the autonomous party visibly enact it.
proposed_design_lessons.proposal: Scout trades split-party exposure for alarm removal; assault must offer a tangible faster/valuable opportunity, rather than simply more enemies. Rescue, medicine and supplies should create distinct next encounters and tangible equipment/support choices.
proposed_design_lessons.acceptance: Two approaches remain defensible in different roster/HP/resource states, with outcome differences demonstrated through production commands.

proposed_design_lessons.lesson: Make a failed rescue and a successful rescue each create a reason to return.
proposed_design_lessons.proposal: Use original hero memories of witnessed decisions, show one useful retained discovery and one concrete next-run preparation. Present loot comparisons/equip and explicit recovery requirements. Keep canonical injury rules unless separately approved.
proposed_design_lessons.acceptance: After result/restart player can name a changed relationship or useful capability and a different intended next-run choice.

existing_pick_me_up_research.limits: Previously compiled NamuWiki community summaries and publisher source. Previously inaccessible Fandom pages remain unverified. Do not treat game-specific numerical formulas as manhwa canon.
